recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed unless Patient Care later decides to reintroduce a Condition-specific target body structure extension.
issue_request: FHIR-13393 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 by Patient Care and requested removing extension-condition-targetbodysite.html because the extension had no definition and was unclear relative to body-site-instance.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-13393-tagged source commit was found. Historical Condition extension spreadsheet snapshots still showed an undefined !targetBodySite row before the R4B/source rework; later rework deleted that spreadsheet and did not carry forward a targetBodySite StructureDefinition or Condition IG reference.
additional_context: Condition remains an active core resource in source/fhir.ini. Current source/condition contains no Condition extension files beyond an empty Condition-core IG shell, no condition-targetBodySite canonical exists in core source or the FHIR Extension Pack, and build.fhir.org returns 404 for extension-condition-targetbodysite.html. The relevant Zulip thread confirms the same overlap/undefined rationale as the Jira issue, and no Confluence or later conflicting decision was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because the obsolete extension is already absent from the current build inputs and external extension repository.
